decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement dated August 2014 and attached drawings 001, 002, 003, 004 and 005 and Noise Assessment dated July 2014 received on 26/08/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for B1(c), B2 or B8 use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The office floorspace contained within the development approved under planning permission 00507/T/P7 shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as warehousing and general industrial and shall not be used for any other purpose

Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the building approved under planning permission 00507/T/P7 by means of horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 6 - No industrial or storage activity shall be carried on outside the buildings approved under planning permission 00507/T/P7 without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 7 - The parking, loading and turning spaces as approved under planning permission 00507/T/P7 and shall be retained and shall not be used for any other purposes
description: Removal of Condition 2 (opening hours) of planning permission 00507/T/P7 dated 22/10/1996 for demolition of existing industrial buildings and redevelopment of site for light industrial use (B1c) general industrial use (B2) and storage and distribution use (B8) with ancillary offices (as varied by planning permission 00507/T/P8 dated 02/03/1999)
